method: Chop the onion finely and fry in olive oil in a large frying pan until nice and caremalised
Meanwhite set a small saucepan on a low heat to warm chicken stock, ladel at the ready
Next chop the chorizo into small pieces - You can add them to the onions when they are translucent
Chop the pumpkins into small 1 cm cubes, salt and coat in olive oil and place in hot oven 200°C (Should take about 20 mins until nice and soft and slightly caramalised)
When the onions and chorizo are ready, add hte arborio rice
Fully coat the rice in oils of pan and fry for about a minute then start adding the white wine
When that has been absorbed, follow with chicken stock 1-2 ladels at a time until al-dente
Finally at the end, mix in pumpkin and the parmesan, and season with a bit of pepper
